releases.title: The Place has an address
notes: Slice stands guard in the Moonlit Hollow, scalpel out. Yo Bots have been told about her.
Wallit has a bat and one job: keep her safe while the Yo Bots and Spider Bots come in waves.
He grows every wave. Bolts level him up, and every level is a choice of boons.
When Slice falls, the run is over. Coins from it buy upgrades for the next one.
Tap to play turns the sound on. Settings keep it where you put it.
